units.implementationStatus: Partial PR12: owning resource-policy registry/owner inspector and explicit resolveResource current stored role intersection. Default deny/no owner bypass, exact resource/member/purpose/action bounds,256 permanent slots/1MiB/no reset or eviction, current owner before cached acknowledgement, CAS/history/audit/outbox and post-read trusted clock. Eight new actual restricted-migration groups and all71 local tests/typecheck/build/registry/strict integration compile pass. Initial source146bb4559c61d9160066ff1c12b267996642b178 CI40783212483 passed66 ordinary and twelve EXISTING PostgreSQL17 regressions, logs inspected. All eight new groups also pass installed compiled public exports/membership and resource-policy JS byte-match. PR12 was accepted at57ffb5ba29cb053ba1b7cb223ff77b04a4fca6af after finalCI40783524213 passed71 ordinary and twelve prior PostgreSQL groups. Existing resolve/capability/session/HTTP consumers unchanged; no automatic resource enforcement, external permit, production auth/canonical resource mapping/network-contention/UI/live qualification. See RESOURCE_POLICIES.md. Partial PR13: seven new actual restricted PostgreSQL17 resource-policy session groups. Real public policy/member transactions are held before COMMIT and independently observed Lock/nonempty blocking PIDs are mandatory. Exact resource resolution denies committed member/purpose/action restrictions and member disable/demotion despite forged roles; cached policy ACK denies committed owner demotion; policy CAS/lost winning COMMIT ACK preserves editions1/2, original historical replay, valid audit and exactly two change outbox entries. Expanded805ed500d4f95f6879db174d532448a3c477dfc6 CI40900061441/check123539568482 passed71 ordinary; postgres123539568631 passed19 actual groups (seven new plus twelve prior) and strict integration compile, head/logs inspected. Initial81974a698710ddba0fe3a6e81788a7b8a6dc7411 CI40899664793 passed71/17. Local71/typecheck/build/registry/strict compile pass; no local PostgreSQL/Docker or new installed-runtime acceptance. Docs/source-bound resource-policy-postgres-verification.json record bounded evidence; actual current-head CI is a merge requirement. Engine runtime/APIs/pins/contracts/workflow/migrations unchanged. Host proofing/canonical resource mapping/current consuming gateways/remote TLS/crash/failover/throughput/multinode and external action fencing/live remain pending.
